description: Output contract for LLM evidence parsing (Appendix B.1).

interpreted_relation.description: Extracted mathematical equation or relation string, e.g. 'new_quantity = 100 - 25'
interpreted_relation.title: Interpreted Relation

evidence_spans.description: Exact substrings from the student input that ground this interpretation
evidence_spans.title: Evidence Spans

candidate_explanations.description: Candidate error hypotheses suggested by student input
candidate_explanations.title: Candidate Explanations

assistance_references.description: Any hints or equations from recent tutor turns that student may have relied on
assistance_references.title: Assistance References

needs_clarification.description: True if input is ambiguous or underspecified
needs_clarification.title: Needs Clarification

title: ExtractorOutputContract
